game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Cold Larder, an ice-cellar larder: the hold guard must handle frozen golems while practicing functions. Core idea – Default Armory: Use default parameter values so the armory works even when arguments are missing.
theme: Snowy Hold – Cold Larder: an ice-cellar larder
core_gameplay_loop: In Cold Larder, repeat each round: Use default parameter values so the armory works even when arguments are missing. Each round, frozen golems strike the beacon fire, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the armor value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the beacon fire from frozen golems in Cold Larder: keep the armor meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 45-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: armor drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 45-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Default Armory
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Default Armory' (Week 6 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Cold Larder'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how armor changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frozen golems in Cold Larder.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 45 seconds while armor > 0.
